leadHtml:
PERF V0.27.0 COMPLETE

@fzlt/core/perf

A live performance overlay for players, off until they switch it on. Frames per second, a rolling frame-time bar chart (one bar per frame, coloured against the budget), dropped frames, the engine's work per frame (read, steps, render), live pooled entities and, where the browser exposes it, the JS heap. It reads the engine's own frames on the shared clock (engine.timing, engine.live): no clock or requestAnimationFrame of its own, and it never calls engine.busy(), so a settling engine still settles and the chart rests with it. Its own cost stays out of what it measures: frame times go into a typed-array ring (nothing is allocated per frame), the numbers are written twice a second through the ledger (change-only, strings cached), the chart is one canvas, and the root is contain: layout paint style and pointer-events: none. Hidden, it only records (a few typed-array writes a frame). Not the dev-only @fzlt/core/debug, which patches Element prototypes: this one ships to players.

EXAMPLE · typechecked against v0.27.0
const overlay = perf(e, { corner: "tr" }); // F9 toggles it
overlay.show(true); // fps, frame-time bars, dropped, work, live, heap
// it reads the engine's frames: no rAF and no allocation of its own

Corner type COMPLETE

A corner of the host: top left, top right, bottom left or bottom right.

export type Corner = "tl" | "tr" | "bl" | "br";

PerfOptions interface COMPLETE

Options for perf(): where the overlay goes, the toggle key and the frame budget.

export interface PerfOptions {
    /** Where the overlay goes (default the engine root, else `document.body`, where it is fixed). */
    host?: HTMLElement | null;
    /** Corner of the host (default "tr"). */
    corner?: Corner;
    /** `KeyboardEvent.code` that toggles it (default "F9"); null for none. */
    key?: string | null;
    /** Shown from the start (default false: players switch it on in Settings). */
    on?: boolean;
    /** The frame budget in ms (default 1000 / 60): a frame over 1.5 budgets counts as dropped. */
    budget?: number;
    /** Called when it is shown or hidden (the key or `show()`): keep a Settings switch in step. */
    change?: (on: boolean) => void;
}
